messages:
maya: Cutoff in ~2h — final version bump, changelog edits, QA gates and security sign-offs expected. Please ack if you're blocking or holding PRs.

sam: Bump PR up: `chore: bump v1.18.0 -> v1.19.0` https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/412

jorge: I'll take the changelog polish now.

release-bot: Canary deploy started for v1.19.0 — canary id c-7782. Rolling 3 instances in us-west-2.

olivia: Canary failing with intermittent 503s on /v1/generate (~1-2%):
```
Request 0x9f1a -> 503
error: kv-cache: alloc failed
stack: runtime/serve.go:142
```

kevin: I'll own canary triage. Reassigning.

maya: Security review needed — @anna did the dependency scan finish?

anna: Snyk scan finished earlier, no criticals. Left a note on one low-sev transitive (pkgX 2.3.1).

sam: QA: smoke tests passed locally, but the rerank e2e is flaky (2 failures in the last run).

jorge: Will rerun e2e once kevin confirms canary is stable.

kevin: Root cause looks like a quantization kernel fallback that spikes memory under certain kv-cache patterns. Created hotfix branch: `hotfix/quant-fallback-313`. Pushing small patch.

olivia: Can we rollback the canary to v1.18.0 until the hotfix is in? We should avoid user impact.

maya: Yes — rollback if fix >30m. kevin, ETA on patch + redeploy?

kevin: Trying a micro-patch now, ETA ~20m. If not good, rollback.

sam: Docs: need a one-liner for the release notes about the kv-cache fallback behavior change. @jorge can you add that to changelog.md?

jorge: Added entry: "Mitigation for rare kv-cache OOM causing 5xxs; fallback stability improvements."

maya: Owners for this final push: sam (release notes), kevin (canary fix), anna (security), jess (QA sign-off). Please confirm ownership here.

jess: I'll sign off once e2e rerun is green. Ping me when CI finishes.

kevin: Patch applied, redeploying canary c-7782 -> redeploy attempt 2.

release-bot: Canary redeploy started for c-7782 (hotfix/quant-fallback-313). Health checks: 0/3 -> warming.

kevin: Observability shows stable memory on the new pods, no alloc spikes.

release-bot: Canary health checks: 3/3. Latency within baseline.

jess: Re-ran e2e suite against canary endpoint — all green. QA sign-off: ✅

anna: Security quick-check: dependency note acknowledged; no blocking items. Security sign-off: ✅

sam: Changelog & version bump merged into release branch. PRs: #412 (bump), #415 (changelog).

maya: Rolling RC cutover in 10m. Final ack?

all: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks everyone — cutting the release now. :partyparrot:
